title_en: Guanyun Zhongfu Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. v. Guanyun County People's Government, et al. — dispute over revocation of government concession agreement
keywords_en: administrative; dispute over revocation of government concession agreement; first instance; Intermediate People's Court; Jiangsu Province; legal person; state organ; Administrative Procedure Law; whether conclusion of administrative agreement follows principle of law-based administration; whether entering into agreement through unfair competition methods constitutes serious and obvious illegality; exceptional circumstances for invalidity of agreement; government concession agreement; waste treatment project; repeated grant of concession rights; principle of law-based administration; administrative litigation
full_text_en:
Guanyun Zhongfu Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. v. Guanyun County People's Government, et al. — Dispute over Revocation of Government Concession Agreement

[Ruling Summary]

The conclusion of administrative agreements shall follow the principle of law-based administration. When concluding administrative agreements such as public utility concession agreements, administrative organs have a pre-contractual obligation to select the contracting party through fair competition methods. Concluding such administrative agreements through non-fair competition methods violates mandatory provisions of laws and regulations and constitutes "major and obvious illegality" as stipulated in Article 75 of the Administrative Procedure Law. Except for a few exceptional circumstances where confirming the invalidity of the agreement would endanger public security, the people's court shall, in accordance with law, render a judgment confirming the invalidity of such administrative agreement.

Plaintiff: Guanyun Zhongfu Environmental Technology Co., Ltd., domiciled at Dayang Village, Nangang Township, Guanyun County, Jiangsu Province.

Legal Representative: Lei Fengxing, Executive Director of the Company.

Defendant: Guanyun County People's Government, domiciled at Xingfu Avenue, Yishan Town, Guanyun County, Jiangsu Province.

Legal Representative: Cao Mingli, County Mayor.

Third Party: Guanyun County Urban Administration Bureau, domiciled at Nanjing West Road, Yishan Town, Guanyun County, Jiangsu Province.

Legal Representative: Shi Shuxiang, Director of the Bureau.

Third Party: China Everbright International Co., Ltd., domiciled at Harcourt Road, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

Legal Representative: Cai Yunge, Executive Director of the Company.

Third Party: Everbright Urban and Rural Renewable Energy (Guanyun) Co., Ltd., domiciled at the south side of Middle Zhejiang Road, Guanyun County Economic Development Zone, Jiangsu Province.

Legal Representative: Sun Xiandong, Chairman of the Company.

The plaintiff, Guanyun Zhongfu Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Zhongfu Company), filed a lawsuit with the Intermediate People's Court of Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province, against the defendant, Guanyun County People's Government (hereinafter referred to as Guanyun County Government), and the third parties, Guanyun County Urban Administration Bureau (hereinafter referred to as Guanyun County Urban Administration Bureau), China Everbright International Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Everbright International Company), and Everbright Urban and Rural Renewable Energy (Guanyun) Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Guanyun Everbright Company), concerning a dispute over the revocation of a government concession agreement.

Plaintiff's Allegations: On September 26, 2011, the defendant, Guanyun County Government, and Zhongfu Company signed the "Guanyun County Urban Domestic Waste Treatment Project Cooperative Construction and Operation Agreement" and a supplementary agreement (hereinafter referred to as the "Zhongfu Project Agreement"), stipulating that Guanyun County Government and Zhongfu Company would cooperate in the construction of the Guanyun County urban domestic waste treatment project, with Guanyun County Government granting Zhongfu Company a concession for a term of 28 years. On October 28, 2011, the Guanyun County Finance Bureau issued a "Letter of Commitment for Payment of Waste Treatment Service Fees for the Guanyun County Urban Domestic Waste Treatment Project," promising to establish a dedicated payment account with a monthly balance of no less than RMB 500,000 at the Yunhai Sub-branch of Bank of China, Guanyun Branch, starting from the commercial operation date for paying Zhongfu Company's waste treatment service fees. On November 4, 2011, the 26th Session of the Standing Committee of the 14th Guanyun County People's Congress considered and approved the "Proposal on Including the Waste Treatment Service Fees for the Guanyun County Urban Domestic Waste Treatment Project in the Guanyun County Fiscal Budget" submitted by Guanyun County Government, agreeing to include the waste treatment service fees stipulated in the Zhongfu Project Agreement in the Guanyun County fiscal budget. On January 31, 2012, the Guanyun County Bureau of Housing and Urban-Rural Development issued to Zhongfu Company a "Project Site Selection Opinion Letter," with the proposed site for the project being Dayang Village, Nangang Township, Guanyun County. Subsequently, after preliminary land review by the Guanyun County Bureau of Land and Resources, environmental impact assessment approval by the Guanyun County Environmental Protection Bureau, and project establishment approval by the Guanyun County Development and Reform Commission, the Guanyun County Bureau of Housing and Urban-Rural Development issued to Zhongfu Company on March 13, 2012, a "Construction Land Use Planning Permit," confirming the project site at Dayang Village, Nangang Township, Guanyun County, with a land area of 124,767 square meters. On September 7, 2012, the Jiangsu Provincial People's Government issued a "Reply on the Construction Land for the Guanyun County Urban Domestic Waste Treatment Project," approving the land supply plan submitted by Guanyun County and allowing the approved construction land to be allocated for the construction of the Guanyun County urban domestic waste treatment project. After the signing of the Zhongfu Project Agreement, Zhongfu Company strictly performed its contractual obligations, investing significant human and material resources in the project's environmental impact assessment, survey, mapping, geological investigation, design, and preliminary construction. However, Guanyun County Government failed to complete the disposal and clearance of property on the project facility site, the relocation and resettlement of residents, and the procedures for free allocation of the site as agreed, causing serious obstacles to and prolonged delay in the project's implementation.

In March 2018, the plaintiff, Zhongfu Company, learned that the defendant, Guanyun County Government, and the third party, Everbright International Company (changed to China Everbright Environment (Group) Co., Ltd. during the second instance of this case), had signed on June 17, 2015, the "Lianyungang City Guanyun County Domestic Waste Incineration Cogeneration BOO Project Concession Agreement" (hereinafter referred to as the "Everbright Project Agreement"), granting Everbright International Company the concession right for waste incineration power generation. Accordingly, the third party, Guanyun Everbright Company, a subsidiary of Everbright International Company, invested an additional RMB 270 million to construct a domestic waste cogeneration project based on a biomass cogeneration project already built in Yufeng Village, Shizhuang Township, Guanyun County, with a daily processing capacity of 500 tons of domestic waste. This project entered trial operation on February 3, 2018. According to the "Environmental Impact Report for the Guanyun County 500 t/d Domestic Waste Incineration Cogeneration Project," the domestic waste cogeneration project processes domestic waste within the Guanyun County area, with a daily collectible waste volume of approximately 180 tons from the county seat and approximately 218 tons from townships, totaling approximately 400 tons per day. Since the domestic waste cogeneration project of Guanyun Everbright Company overlaps with the domestic waste treatment project of Zhongfu Company in terms of waste collection, transportation, and processing scope, and since Zhongfu Company has priority rights over waste treatment construction projects beyond the Guanyun county seat and surrounding townships, Zhongfu Company believes that by signing the Everbright Project Agreement with Everbright International Company within the scope of Zhongfu Company's domestic waste treatment concession, Guanyun County Government has violated the Zhongfu Project Agreement. Zhongfu Company contends that the granting of the domestic waste incineration power generation concession right to Everbright International Company and Guanyun Everbright Company by Guanyun County Government is illegal in both substance and procedure and should be revoked. In June 2018, Zhongfu Company sent a letter and engaged lawyers to negotiate with Guanyun County Government and Guanyun Everbright Company, but received no response. In summary, Zhongfu Company requests the court to confirm that the act of Guanyun County Government in granting the domestic waste incineration cogeneration concession to Guanyun Everbright Company is illegal and to revoke it.

Defendant's Defense: Guanyun County Government argued that the Zhongfu Project Agreement is a civil contract relationship and has not been actually performed. The plaintiff, Zhongfu Company, has not invested in, constructed, or operated the project in accordance with the agreement and does not meet the conditions for further obtaining the right to operate urban domestic waste treatment under the agreement, nor has it actually obtained the concession right. According to the agreement, if waste treatment facilities need to be constructed within the jurisdiction of Guanyun County, Zhongfu Company has the priority right to construct and operate under equal conditions, not a concession right. The Everbright Project Agreement was signed under the urgent need to solve the waste treatment problem in Guanyun County and is an investment project involving social public interest; it is already in production and operation. Due to Zhongfu Company's inability to perform, the purpose of the Zhongfu Project Agreement is objectively unattainable. Guanyun County Government's transfer of the domestic waste treatment right to the third party, Everbright International Company, is in line with social public interests and is not revocable. Additionally, the agreement stipulates that disputes shall be submitted to the Shanghai Arbitration Commission for arbitration; this case does not fall within the scope of administrative case acceptance. Zhongfu Company's lawsuit exceeds the statutory limitation period. The defendant requests the court to hear the case fairly, reject Zhongfu Company's claims, or dismiss the lawsuit.

Statement of Third Party Guanyun County Urban Administration Bureau: It expressed the same opinion as the defendant, Guanyun County Government.

Statements of Third Parties Everbright International Company and Guanyun Everbright Company: They argued that the plaintiff's Zhongfu Company project has not been completed and the concession right claimed in this lawsuit has not actually been established. The project under the Everbright Project Agreement has been completed and is providing services for the active development of society; it is not revocable. Their other opinions are the same as those of the defendant, Guanyun County Government.

Facts Found by the Court of First Instance (Intermediate People's Court of Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province):

On September 26, 2011, the defendant, Guanyun County Government (the concession grantor), and the plaintiff, Zhongfu Company (the project company), signed the Zhongfu Project Agreement, agreeing to jointly invest in the design, financing, construction, operation, and buyback of the Guanyun County urban domestic waste treatment project. The main contents are: ... 1.4 The concession grantor is willing to cooperate with the project company to jointly construct the Guanyun County urban domestic waste treatment project and grant the project company a concession right for a term of twenty-eight (28) years. During the concession period, the project company shall, in accordance with the terms and conditions of this agreement, implement the design, financing, construction, operation, and buyback of the project. 1.6.1 In accordance with the provisions of this agreement, Guanyun County Government grants the project company the right to design, finance, construct, and operate the project. 2.1.26 Commercial Operation Start Date: Means the date on which the construction of the project is completed and the formal operation of the project facilities begins. From that date, the project company shall operate the project facilities in accordance with this agreement, and the concession grantor shall begin paying the waste treatment service fees to the project company in accordance with this agreement. ... 2.1.28 Concession Right: Means that the owner of the construction and operation right of Guanyun County's municipal waste treatment facilities, i.e., the concession grantor, grants such rights to the project company in accordance with the specific provisions of this agreement and under Chinese law, including: the right to design, finance, construct, and operate the project; the right to obtain corresponding revenue during the operation of the project and to generate revenue through waste reuse; and the exclusive right of first refusal over all subsequently planned waste treatment facilities within the Guanyun county seat and its surrounding townships. ... 3.2.1 Unless extended or terminated early in accordance with this agreement, the concession period shall be twenty-eight (28) years from the Commercial Operation Start Date; the trial operation period shall be included in this period. 4.1.1 The concession grantor shall ensure that, before the commencement of the project construction, the project company obtains a lawful land use right certificate for the project facility site in compliance with the relevant national land regulations. ... 4.1.2 The concession grantor ensures that, before the commencement of the project construction, there is no property owned by any natural person, legal person, or any other organization or individual on the project facility site, nor any obstacles or legacy issues related to their property. 4.1.3 The concession grantor shall be responsible for the relocation and resettlement of residents who must be relocated within the scope required by relevant national norms outside the project facility site. ... 7.1.8 During the construction and operation of the project, as agreed by both parties, the concession grantor shall contact relevant departments to provide public safety guarantee for the project company. If, during the normal construction and operation of the project, surrounding residents obstruct the normal progress of construction and operation, the concession grantor shall take immediate measures to resolve the issue. ... 8.3.1.4 If the concession grantor's breach of this agreement causes the project company to fail to perform its obligations on time, the project company has the right to correspondingly extend the period for performing its obligations. ... 9.1 Without the prior written consent of the project company, the concession grantor shall not transfer or assign all or part of the rights or obligations under this agreement. ... 11.2.2 If the dispute remains unresolved within thirty (30) days after attempting friendly consultation in accordance with Article 11.2.1, either party has the right to submit the dispute to the Shanghai Arbitration Commission for arbitration.

On October 28, 2011, the Guanyun County Finance Bureau issued to the plaintiff, Zhongfu Company, a "Letter of Commitment for Payment of Waste Treatment Service Fees for the Guanyun County Urban Domestic Waste Treatment Project," with the main content being: The Guanyun County Finance Bureau undertakes to pay directly to Zhongfu Company each month the waste treatment service fees determined in the "Waste Treatment Service Fee Payment Notice" issued by Guanyun County Government to the Guanyun County Finance Bureau, with the nature of payment being a fiscal subsidy.

On November 4, 2011, the Standing Committee of the Guanyun County People's Congress issued to the defendant, Guanyun County Government, a "Resolution on Agreeing to Include the Waste Treatment Service Fees for the Guanyun County Urban Domestic Waste Treatment Project in the Fiscal Budget" (Guanyuan [2011] No. 30), with the main content being: It agreed to include the waste treatment service fees stipulated in the Zhongfu Project Agreement in the Guanyun County fiscal budget.

On February 21, 2012, the former Guanyun County Environmental Protection Bureau issued to the plaintiff, Zhongfu Company, a "Reply on the Environmental Impact Report for the Guanyun County Urban Domestic Waste Treatment Project Constructed by Guanyun Zhongfu Environmental Technology Co., Ltd." (Huanhuan Zi [2012] No. 13), with the main content being: From an environmental protection perspective, it approved the construction of the project at the designated site in Dayang Village, Nangang Township, Guanyun County, in accordance with the contents of the environmental impact report. On the same day, Zhongfu Company also obtained the project establishment approval for the Guanyun County urban domestic waste treatment project.

On March 13, 2012, the Guanyun County Bureau of Housing and Urban-Rural Development issued to the plaintiff, Zhongfu Company, a "Construction Land Use Planning Permit," with the land use project name being "Guanyun County Urban Domestic Waste Treatment Project" and the land location being Dayang Village, Nangang Township, Guanyun County.

On September 7, 2012, the Jiangsu Provincial People's Government issued to the Lianyungang Municipal People's Government a "Reply of the Jiangsu Provincial People's Government on the Construction Land for the Guanyun County Urban Domestic Waste Treatment Project" (Suzheng Di [2012] No. 445), with the main content being: It approved the agricultural land conversion plan and land acquisition plan for Guanyun County, approved the land supply plan for Guanyun County, and agreed that the approved construction land be allocated for the construction of the Guanyun County urban domestic waste treatment project.

During the above period, the plaintiff, Zhongfu Company, invested certain human and financial resources in the planned construction of the Guanyun County urban domestic waste treatment project. Due to opposition from local villagers at the selected site, the facilities involved in the Zhongfu Project Agreement were not actually constructed or put into operation. The cooperative project between Zhongfu Company and the defendant, Guanyun County Government, was suspended.

On June 17, 2015, the defendant, Guanyun County Government, authorized the third party, Guanyun County Urban Administration Bureau, to sign the Everbright Project Agreement with the investor, the third party, Everbright International Company, granting the third party, Guanyun Everbright Company, a subsidiary of Everbright International Company, the exclusive right to invest, design, construct, own, operate, and maintain a waste incineration cogeneration plant with an annual waste treatment capacity of 182,500 tons, to provide domestic waste incineration treatment and park heating services to Guanyun County. The main contents are: ... The parties to the agreement are: Guanyun County Government authorizes Guanyun County Urban Administration Bureau (Party A); Guanyun Everbright Company (Party B); Everbright International Company (Investor) ... 2.1 Grant of Concession Right: Party A grants Party B the exclusive right to invest, design, construct, own, operate, and maintain a waste incineration cogeneration plant with an annual waste treatment capacity of 182,500 tons, to provide domestic waste incineration treatment and park heating services to Guanyun County. ... 2.4 Concession Period: The concession period shall be 30 years from the date of commencement of piling work on site for the waste incineration cogeneration plant ... From the signing of the agreement to October 2018, Guanyun Everbright Company, established with capital from Everbright International Company, successively obtained a project site selection opinion letter, a construction land use planning permit, a real property certificate, a construction project planning permit, a reply approving the project for the combined biomass cogeneration and domestic waste incineration cogeneration project's supporting transmission line, an access system design review opinion for the waste incineration cogeneration project (9 MW), and a certificate of verification for completion of construction works planning. The project is located in the Guanyun Economic Development Zone and is primarily responsible for the domestic waste incineration treatment within the Guanyun County area. It has now been put into actual production and operation.

After learning of the above circumstances, on June 13, 2018, the plaintiff, Zhongfu Company, sent letters to the defendant, Guanyun County Government, and the third parties, Everbright International Company and Guanyun Everbright Company, to protect its rights (hereinafter referred to as the "rights-protection letters"). Neither Guanyun County Government, Everbright International Company, nor Guanyun Everbright Company replied. Zhongfu Company thereafter instituted this lawsuit, requesting the court to confirm that the act of Guanyun County Government in granting the domestic waste incineration cogeneration concession to Guanyun Everbright Company was illegal and to revoke it.

Opinion of the Court of First Instance (Intermediate People's Court of Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province):

The dispute in this case centers on four issues: (1) whether the dispute in this case falls within the scope of acceptance of administrative litigation; (2) whether the plaintiff, Zhongfu Company, has standing to bring this lawsuit; (3) whether Zhongfu Company's lawsuit exceeds the statutory limitation period; and (4) whether Zhongfu Company's claims should be upheld and how its rights should be protected.

Regarding Issue 1: Article 12, Paragraph 1, Items 11 and 12 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the PRC provide that a citizen, legal person, or other organization may file a lawsuit with the people's court if it considers that an administrative organ has failed to perform or performed in accordance with agreement, or has illegally changed or terminated a government concession agreement, a land and house expropriation compensation agreement, or other agreements; or if it considers that the administrative organ has infringed upon its lawful rights and interests such as personal rights or property rights. Article 2 of the "Administrative Measures for Concession of Municipal Public Utilities" stipulates: "Concession of municipal public utilities refers to the system whereby the government, in accordance with relevant laws and regulations, selects investors or operators of municipal public utilities through a market competition mechanism and defines their operation of certain municipal public utility products or provision of certain services for a certain period and within a certain scope. This Measure applies to industries such as urban water supply, gas supply, heating, public transportation, sewage treatment, and waste treatment that implement concession in accordance with law." The contents of both the Zhongfu Project Agreement and the Everbright Project Agreement in this case are centered on urban waste treatment, which aligns with the nature and characteristics of government concession agreements. The plaintiff, Zhongfu Company, filed this lawsuit based on the two agreements, and the people's court shall accept it in accordance with law. Although the Zhongfu Project Agreement contains a clause regarding dispute resolution, the substantive purpose of Zhongfu Company's lawsuit is to exclude the competitive rights or concession rights of the third parties, Everbright International Company and Guanyun Everbright Company, arising from the subsequent Everbright Project Agreement, and is not limited to the internal legal relationship under the Zhongfu Project Agreement. Therefore, the opinion of the defendant, Guanyun County Government, and the third parties, Guanyun County Urban Administration Bureau, Everbright International Company, and Guanyun Everbright Company, that Zhongfu Company should apply to the Shanghai Arbitration Commission for arbitration, is not upheld.

## Regarding Disputed Issue II

Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "A person or entity that is the counterparty of an administrative act, or any other citizen, legal person, or organization that has an interest in the administrative act, has the right to bring a lawsuit." This provision reflects a subjective litigation nature that places greater emphasis on rights remedy. Generally, whether a party has standing as a plaintiff is assessed from the following three aspects: first, whether the administrative act is related to an increase or decrease in rights or obligations; second, whether actual litigation benefits can be obtained after filing the lawsuit; third, whether the party can bear the rights and obligations determined by the judgment after the lawsuit concludes. In this case, after the performance of the *Guangda Project Agreement*, the third party Guanyun Guangda Company has objectively and actually become the subject of the franchise right for urban domestic waste treatment within Guanyun County. Under such circumstances, this directly frustrates the purpose of continued performance of the prior *Zhongfu Project Agreement*. Therefore, regardless of whether the plaintiff Zhongfu Company actually obtained the franchise right, because the existence of the *Guangda Project Agreement* has objectively affected Zhongfu Company's contractual rights, it should be confirmed that Zhongfu Company has the standing as a plaintiff in this litigation.

## Regarding Disputed Issue III

Article 64, Paragraph 1 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "Where an administrative agency, when making an administrative act, fails to inform a citizen, legal person, or other organization of the time limit for filing a lawsuit, the time limit for filing a lawsuit shall be calculated from the date the citizen, legal person, or other organization knows or should know of the time limit for filing a lawsuit, but shall not exceed one year from the date they know or should know the content of the administrative act." In this case, there is no evidence proving that the plaintiff Zhongfu Company knew of the execution of the *Guangda Project Agreement*, nor is there evidence proving that the defendant Guanyun County Government informed Zhongfu Company of the relevant circumstances, such as the grant of the franchise right to the third party Guanyun Guangda Company, the right to sue, or the time limit for filing a lawsuit. Therefore, Zhongfu Company, after failing to obtain remedies from Guanyun County Government and the third parties Guangda International Company and Guanyun Guangda Company on June 13, 2018, filed this lawsuit with the People's Court. This did not exceed the statutory time limit for filing a lawsuit.

## Regarding Disputed Issue IV

Article 8 of the Administrative Measures for Franchising of Municipal Public Utilities stipulates that the competent authority shall select investors or operators for municipal public utility franchise projects in accordance with procedures such as publicly inviting bids and accepting tenders. Article 26, Paragraph 1 of the Administrative Measures for Urban Domestic Waste stipulates that the construction (environmental sanitation) competent authorities of municipalities, cities, and counties shall make decisions on granting permits for the operational disposal of urban domestic waste through fair competition methods such as tendering, and issue a Permit for Operational Disposal Service of Urban Domestic Waste to the winning bidder. The franchise right challenged in this case should be granted only after undergoing procedures such as tendering in accordance with the procedures established by the above legal norms. However, the defendant Guanyun County Government did not provide evidence proving that it granted the franchise right to the plaintiff Zhongfu Company or the third party Guanyun Guangda Company in accordance with the procedures specified in the above legal norms. On this basis, the execution of both agreements involved in this case was procedurally illegal. The opinion of Zhongfu Company that Guanyun County Government's act of granting the challenged franchise right to Guanyun Guangda Company was illegal should be supported.

Regarding whether the act should be revoked: Article 74, Paragraph 1, Item 1 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "Where an administrative act falls under any of the following circumstances, the People's Court shall confirm the act illegal but shall not revoke it: (1) The administrative act should be revoked according to law, but revocation would cause major harm to national interests or social public interests." In this case, the construction of the waste-to-energy and biomass cogeneration project built by Guanyun Guangda Company has been completed, accepted, and put into operation. If this authorization act were revoked, it would not only affect the acquired rights and interests of Guanyun Guangda Company but also affect the unified management of urban domestic waste by residents and harm the public interest within the region. Therefore, the court does not support Zhongfu Company's request to revoke Guanyun County Government's act of granting the challenged franchise right to Guanyun Guangda Company. Pursuant to Article 76 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, when a People's Court confirms an act illegal or invalid, it may also order the Guanyun County Government to take remedial measures. In this case, from the perspective of reasonableness, since Zhongfu Company has indeed incurred certain costs for its own project operation, and based on the evidence in this case, Guanyun County Government did not issue any written notice to Zhongfu Company requiring continued performance or termination of the *Zhongfu Project Agreement*. Therefore, the expected interests related to the agreement that Zhongfu Company should have enjoyed have not been realized. Now that the *Guangda Project Agreement* has actually made it difficult for the *Zhongfu Project Agreement* to continue to be performed, regarding how to properly resolve the agreement dispute between Zhongfu Company and Guanyun County Government, Guanyun County Government bears the obligation to take corresponding remedial measures. It should proactively perform its administrative duties and make an administrative disposition according to law.

In summary, the defendant Guanyun County Government's act of granting the franchise right to the third party Guanyun Guangda Company was procedurally illegal. However, given that revoking this administrative act would cause major harm to social public interests, it should be confirmed illegal according to law, and the court does not support the plaintiff Zhongfu Company's claim for revocation. The Intermediate People's Court of Lianyungang City, Jiangsu Province, in accordance with Article 74, Paragraph 1, Item 1 and Article 76 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, rendered the following judgment on January 17, 2020:

1.  Confirmed that the act of the defendant, the People's Government of Guanyun County, granting the franchise right to the third party, Guangda Urban and Rural Renewable Energy (Guanyun) Co., Ltd., was illegal;
2.  Ordered the defendant, the People's Government of Guanyun County, to take corresponding remedial measures within six months from the effective date of this judgment;
3.  Dismissed the other claims of the plaintiff, Guanyun Zhongfu Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd.

Zhongfu Company, dissatisfied with the first-instance judgment, appealed to the High People's Court of Jiangsu Province. The main reasons were: the first-instance judgment omitted important facts, failing to clearly determine that the appellee Guanyun County Government had granted duplicate franchise rights, nor did it clearly determine that Guanyun County Government's grant of the franchise right to the original third party Guanyun Guangda Company infringed upon the appellant Zhongfu Company's already-obtained franchise right. Revoking the franchise right illegally granted by Guanyun County Government to Guanyun Guangda Company in this case would not cause major harm to social public interests. The appellant requested the court of second instance to set aside item 3 of the first-instance judgment and instead rule to revoke the franchise right for the waste incineration cogeneration project granted by Guanyun County Government to Guanyun Guangda Company.

The appellee, Guanyun County Government, argued in its defense: The appellant Zhongfu Company did not actually perform the *Zhongfu Project Agreement*, making the purpose of the contract unattainable. Zhongfu Company did not obtain the franchise right for urban domestic waste treatment in Guanyun County. According to the *Zhongfu Project Agreement*, after its execution, if waste treatment-related facilities needed to be constructed within the jurisdiction of Guanyun County, the project company under the *Zhongfu Project Agreement* only had a priority right to construct and operate under equal conditions. According to Article 8 of the Administrative Measures for Franchising of Municipal Public Utilities and Article 26, Paragraph 1 of the Administrative Measures for Urban Domestic Waste, the *Zhongfu Project Agreement*, which was not tendered through an open procedure, was illegal. Zhongfu Company had no right to raise objections regarding the *Guangda Project Agreement*. The *Guangda Project Agreement* is an investment project involving public interests. The project has been completed, accepted, and put into operation. Revoking this authorization act would not only affect the acquired rights and interests of the original third party Guanyun Guangda Company but also affect the unified management of urban domestic waste by residents and harm the public interest within the region. Zhongfu Company's request to set aside item 3 of the first-instance judgment lacks factual basis and legal basis. The appellee requested the court of second instance to dismiss the appeal and affirm the original judgment.

The defense opinions of the appellee, Guanyun County Urban Management Bureau, were the same as those of the appellee Guanyun County Government.

The original third party, China Everbright Environment (Group) Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Everbright Environment Group Company, formerly Everbright International Company), argued: The waste treatment methods specified in the *Guangda Project Agreement* and the *Zhongfu Project Agreement* are different. Moreover, the appellant Zhongfu Company did not actually perform the *Zhongfu Project Agreement*, and the legal rights and interests it claims have not yet been formed. Therefore, Zhongfu Company lacks the basis for standing to sue in this case. Everbright Environment Group Company was unaware that Zhongfu Company had previously signed an agreement with the appellee Guanyun County Government. Everbright Environment Group Company's implementation of the *Guangda Project Agreement* according to law was not improper and did not infringe upon the lawful rights and interests of Zhongfu Company. There are no grounds for finding the *Guangda Project Agreement* invalid. If the *Guangda Project Agreement* were found invalid or revoked, stopping the franchise project involved would affect the local public environment and could lead to new disputes with Guanyun County Government, causing harm to public interests. The original third party requested the court of second instance to dismiss the appeal and affirm the original judgment.

The original third party, Guanyun Guangda Company, argued: It agreed with the defense opinions of the appellees Guanyun County Government and Guanyun County Urban Management Bureau. It further argued that the *Guangda Project Agreement* does not fall under the grounds for invalidity of a contract stipulated in Article 52 of the former Contract Law of the People's Republic of China. Furthermore, the waste treatment technology adopted by the appellant Zhongfu Company is now outdated. The original third party requested the court of second instance to dismiss the appeal and affirm the original judgment.

The High People's Court of Jiangsu Province found upon retrial: Based on the evidence on file, the time "June 13, 2018" found by the first-instance judgment for the date the appellant Zhongfu Company sent letters to assert its rights should be corrected to "June 14, 2018". The other facts of the case found by the first-instance judgment were confirmed.

Further investigation revealed: The dominant process for urban domestic waste treatment specified in the *Zhongfu Project Agreement* was a resource recovery process combined with sanitary landfill treatment. According to the original of the *Guangda Project Agreement* produced by the appellee Guanyun County Urban Management Bureau during the trial of this case, the franchise project involved in the *Guangda Project Agreement* stipulated a planned land area of 100 mu. During the trial of this case, none of the parties submitted to the court evidence that the franchise project involved in the *Guangda Project Agreement* had obtained the corresponding administrative license for waste disposal. During the second-instance trial, the appellant Zhongfu Company confirmed that the waste treatment technology stipulated in the *Guangda Project Agreement* was more advanced. The appellee Guanyun County Government confirmed that, prior to concluding the *Guangda Project Agreement*, it did not notify the public or relevant interested parties, nor did it issue tender documents, regarding the franchise project involved. It also confirmed that if the franchise project had been subject to open competition, Zhongfu Company could have participated in that competition. It also confirmed that the facility built under the *Guangda Project Agreement* is currently the only comprehensive waste treatment facility in Guanyun County. The original third party, Everbright Environment Group Company, confirmed that it has industry competitors in relation to the franchise project involved in the *Guangda Project Agreement*.

## Opinion of the High People's Court of Jiangsu Province (Court of Second Instance)

I. Regarding whether the dispute in this case falls within the scope of administrative litigation and whether the appellant Zhongfu Company has standing as a plaintiff to file this lawsuit

The court of first instance provided sufficient reasoning, with factual basis and legal basis, for its determination that the dispute in this case falls within the scope of administrative litigation and that the appellant Zhongfu Company has standing as a plaintiff to file this lawsuit. The court of second instance adopts this reasoning and does not repeat it.

II. Regarding whether the appellant Zhongfu Company's filing of this lawsuit exceeded the statutory time limit

Article 25 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Trial of Administrative Agreement Cases stipulates: "Where a citizen, legal person, or other organization files a lawsuit against an administrative agency's failure to perform an administrative agreement according to law or perform it as agreed, the statute of limitations shall be determined by reference to civil legal norms; where a lawsuit is filed against an administrative act such as an administrative agency's modification or termination of an administrative agreement, the time limit for filing the lawsuit shall be determined in accordance with the Administrative Procedure Law and its judicial interpretations." According to the foregoing provisions, for acts by an administrative agency that reflect unilateral and authoritative characteristics, such as modifying or terminating an administrative agreement, the relevant provisions on the time limit for filing a lawsuit under administrative procedure apply. For cases filed against acts that do not involve the administrative agency's unilateral exercise of power, such as failure to perform or failure to perform as agreed under an administrative agreement, the relevant provisions of civil legal norms on the statute of limitations shall apply by reference. The subject matter challenged in this case does not involve an act by the administrative agency exercising its power unilaterally. Therefore, the review of whether the appellant Zhongfu Company's filing of this lawsuit exceeded the statutory time limit should apply by reference the relevant provisions of civil legal norms on the statute of limitations. The court of first instance's application of the relevant provisions on the time limit for filing a lawsuit under administrative procedure constituted an error in the application of law. The court of second instance corrects this error according to law. In this case, according to Zhongfu Company's statement, it only learned of the existence of the *Guangda Project Agreement* in March 2018. None of the other parties provided evidence proving that Zhongfu Company had previously known of the execution or implementation of the *Guangda Project Agreement*. Therefore, Zhongfu Company's filing of this lawsuit in July 2018 did not exceed the statute of limitations stipulated in the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, which was applicable at that time.

III. Regarding the legality and validity of the *Guangda Project Agreement*

An administrative agreement is an agreement concluded through negotiation between an administrative agency and a citizen, legal person, or other organization for the purpose of achieving administrative management or public service goals, containing rights and obligations under administrative law. The essential difference between an administrative agreement and a civil contract lies in the fact that administrativeness is a general attribute of administrative agreements. This determines that, from the moment the administrative agency commences the act of contracting, it begins to perform its public functions, with the primary purpose of achieving public interests. Therefore, the conclusion of an administrative agreement should fundamentally adhere to the principle of law-based administration, which is consistent with the administrative nature of the agreement. Specifically, before concluding an administrative agreement, the administrative agency should ensure, according to law, that the selection of the contracting party and the content of the agreement comply with the provisions of relevant legal norms enacted by the state to safeguard and realize public interests. This is the pre-contractual duty that an administrative agency must fulfill before concluding an administrative agreement. The administrative agency's pre-contractual duty commences when the contracting process is initiated and is not affected by whether the administrative agreement is ultimately concluded or becomes effective. The administrative agency may not exclude or waive the fulfillment of this pre-contractual duty due to non-legal factors. Among the administrative agency's pre-contractual duties, if the legal norms require the administrative agency to select the contracting party for an administrative agreement through fair competition methods, whether this pre-contractual duty has been fulfilled is a critical factor in determining the validity of this administrative agreement.

Building a unified, open, competitive, and orderly market system is fundamental to enabling the market to play a decisive role in resource allocation. Fundamentally, fair competition is a basic component and the lifeblood and essential characteristic of a market economy. Unfair competition can directly or indirectly infringe upon the legitimate rights of other market entities, disrupt market order, worsen the business environment, hinder national innovation, and induce abuse of power. The orderly conclusion of administrative agreements according to law is crucial for the construction of China's market system. Therefore, during the process of concluding an administrative agreement, the administrative agency's act of governing according to law, fulfilling its pre-contractual duties, and ensuring and achieving fair competition plays a fundamentally supporting role in maintaining national economic order, social order, and public interests, as well as protecting the lawful rights and interests of contracting parties and potential contracting parties. Regarding the conclusion of franchise agreements for public utilities such as waste treatment involved in this case, China's relevant legal norms also clearly stipulate the pre-contractual duties that administrative agencies must fulfill. Article 3 of the Administrative Measures for Concessions of Infrastructure and Public Utilities stipulates: "For the purposes of these Measures, the term 'concession of infrastructure and public utilities' means the government authorizing, through competitive methods according to law, legal persons or other organizations within or outside the territory of the People's Republic of China, clarifying the rights, obligations, and risk allocation through an agreement, and stipulating that they invest in, construct, operate infrastructure and public utilities within a certain period and scope, obtain income, and provide public goods or services." Article 15 stipulates: "The implementing agency shall select the concessionaire through competitive methods such as tendering or competitive negotiation based on the approved project implementation plan for the concession project. If the construction and operation standards and regulatory requirements for the concession project are clear and competition in the relevant field of the market is relatively sufficient, the concessionaire shall be selected through tendering." According to the foregoing provisions, when an administrative agency concludes an administrative agreement of the public utility concession category, fulfilling its pre-contractual duties and selecting the contracting party through fair competition methods is a mandatory requirement of the legal norms. Specifically: First, the administrative agency must ensure and realize equal opportunities for potential contracting parties to participate in competition. This requires the administrative agency to establish legal, reasonable, and uniformly applied standards for determining qualifications, and fairly determine the scope of potential contracting parties; and to provide equal contracting opportunities to potential contracting parties through standardized competitive methods such as tendering and competitive negotiation, and ensure they receive equal treatment. Second, the administrative agency must ensure and realize outcome fairness in determining the contracting party from among the potential contracting parties. Generally, if a potential contracting party wins in fair competition, it has the right to request the administrative agency to enter into an administrative agreement with it as the contracting party.

Article 75 of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "Where an administrative act has a major and obvious illegal circumstance such as the implementing entity lacks administrative subject qualification or has no legal basis, and the plaintiff requests the court to confirm the administrative act as null and void, the people's court shall render a judgment confirming it as null and void." Article 12, paragraph 1 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Trial of Administrative Agreement Cases provides: "Where an administrative agreement falls under the circumstances of major and obvious illegality as prescribed in Article 75 of the Administrative Procedure Law, the people's court shall confirm the administrative agreement as null and void." The Appellant, Zhongfu Company, filed this lawsuit requesting the court to confirm that the act of the Appellee, Guanyun County Government, in granting the concession for the waste-to-energy combined heat and power project to the Third Party at First Instance, Guanyun Everbright Company, was illegal and to revoke it. Because this concession right is a general reflection of the contents of the *Everbright Project Agreement*, the substance of Zhongfu Company's claim is a request to review the legality of the *Everbright Project Agreement*. In this case, neither Guanyun County Government nor any other party to the case provided evidence to prove that Guanyun County Government or its authorized entity fulfilled the pre-contractual obligations in accordance with legal provisions and selected the contracting party for the concession project involved in the *Everbright Project Agreement* through fair competition. Because Guanyun County Government did not ensure or realize equal opportunities for potential contracting parties to participate in the competition for the concession project involved in the *Everbright Project Agreement*, it was also impossible to ensure or realize a fair outcome for potential contracting parties to prevail in fair competition. Given that the conclusion of the *Everbright Project Agreement* through non-fair competition methods in this case has no legal basis and clearly violates mandatory provisions of legal norms, constituting major and obvious illegality, the *Everbright Project Agreement* should, according to law, be an invalid administrative agreement. The court of first instance held that the project constructed by Guanyun Everbright Company pursuant to the *Everbright Project Agreement* had been completed, accepted, and put into operation. If the authorization act were to be revoked, it would not only affect the rights and interests already acquired by Guanyun Everbright Company, but also impact the unified management of urban household waste and harm public interests within the region. Based on this reasoning, the court of first instance rendered its judgment, thereby preserving the substantive effect of the *Everbright Project Agreement*. The court of second instance held that, for public utilities or other administrative agreements that should, according to law, select the contracting party through fair competition, if they are concluded without using fair competition methods, except for a few exceptional circumstances such as where confirming the agreement as null and void or revoking it may endanger public safety, if the effectiveness of such administrative agreements is effectively preserved merely by confirming their illegality simply because a *fait accompli* has been established, it will inevitably create a loophole in the system, seriously harming market order and the overall public interest. Given that the *Everbright Project Agreement* in this case does not fall under an exceptional circumstance, the first-instance judgment's confirmation of the illegality of the *Everbright Project Agreement* without confirming its nullity constituted an error in the application of law, which the court of second instance corrected according to law. Because the aforementioned claims made by Zhongfu Company when filing this lawsuit were, in substance, a single claim, the first-instance judgment's handling of them separately was improper, and the court of second instance also corrected this according to law. Article 15, paragraph 2 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Trial of Administrative Agreement Cases provides: "Where an administrative agreement is confirmed as null and void or revoked due to the defendant's reasons, the court may simultaneously order the defendant to take remedial measures; ..." After the *Everbright Project Agreement* is confirmed null and void by judgment in this case, Guanyun County Government and its relevant functional departments shall actively perform their administrative management and service functions, take remedial measures according to law, and ensure the continuous, stable, and safe provision of the public products and public services involved in this case. In this way, the potential harm to the relevant public interests within the specific region of Guanyun County, which was the concern of the first-instance judgment, can be effectively controlled. If Guanyun County Government and its relevant functional departments neglect to perform the aforementioned duties, they shall bear corresponding legal liability according to law. It should be pointed out that constructing a sound market order and optimizing the business environment requires the safeguarding role of the rule of law in consolidating fundamentals, stabilizing expectations, and benefiting the long term. The rule of law is governance by rules. The most important and fundamental requirement in building a law-based government is administration according to law. In this case, because Guanyun County Government failed to comply with the relevant provisions of legal norms regarding the selection of contracting parties through fair competition, it created the dispute at issue, which has lingered for many years, directly led to the invalidity of the *Everbright Project Agreement*, and caused serious risks and hidden dangers to the public interest and the relevant parties of the *Everbright Project Agreement*. It is hoped that Guanyun County Government and its relevant functional departments can take the adjudication of this case as an opportunity to deepen the concept that the rule of law is the best business environment, continuously strengthen, improve, and perfect the construction of the rule of law in areas such as administrative management and service, and at the same time actively and steadily implement the remedial measures related to this case, effectively making the rule of law an important symbol of the core competitiveness of local economic and social development and a strong guarantee for a sound market order and business environment.

In summary, in accordance with Article 75 and Article 89, paragraph 1, item (2) of the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and Article 12, paragraph 1 and Article 15, paragraph 2 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Trial of Administrative Agreement Cases, the Jiangsu High People's Court rendered the following judgment on July 29, 2021:

1. The administrative judgment (2018) Su 07 Xing Chu No. 42 of the Lianyungang Intermediate People's Court of Jiangsu Province is hereby vacated;

2. It is confirmed that the *Lianyungang Guanyun County Household Waste Incineration Combined Heat and Power Plant BOO Project Concession Agreement* signed by the Appellee, Guanyun County Government, authorizing the Appellee, Guanyun County Urban Administration Bureau, with the Third Party at First Instance, China Everbright Environment (Group) Co., Ltd., on June 17, 2015, is null and void;

3. Effective from the date this judgment takes effect, the Appellee, Guanyun County Government, shall take remedial measures according to law, perform its administrative management and service functions, and ensure the continuous, stable, and safe provision of the public products and public services related to the concession project covered by the *Lianyungang Guanyun County Household Waste Incineration Combined Heat and Power Plant BOO Project Concession Agreement*.
